mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the returning fluid to precipitate minerals made the connection between circulation and vent deposits clear and satisfying.

leastWorthwhile.text: The consecutive heating and hot-rock interaction felt a little repetitive, although the second added the important chemistry.

surprise.text: The plume's visible material is suspended minerals, not smoke.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though several steps offered only one combination, so the route required little decision-making.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the consequences of the circulation, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
